  and power. We build dams to stop water flow. These
  dams make lakes and generate electricity. Boats
  travel on some rivers for trade. Rivers shape the
  land over long time periods. Erosion from flowing
  water cuts deep valleys. Rivers support many plants

  Wetlands near rivers hold water and protect soil.
